name: tailwindcss-buttons
title: Tailwind CSS Buttons
blurb: Collection of button styles with hover effects.
description: A showcase component rendering multiple button variations (default, outline, secondary, ghost) with hover state transitions.
use_when: You need a reference of button style patterns or a multi-variant button gallery.
avoid_when: As a single button component; it is a showcase/demo card, not a reusable button.
a11y: Buttons have standard semantics but lack individual labeling; meant as a demo.
